text: Given valid Gorelo credentials and no filters, when gorelo_list_tickets is called, then it returns up to limit (default 50, max 200) tickets with the required fields and the {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count} envelope.

Given gorelo_list_tickets(status_names="NoSuchStatus"), when the name does not resolve against gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, then it returns invalid_argument naming the known status values, without calling the Gorelo tickets endpoint.
Given gorelo_list_tickets(priority_names="urgent,bogus"), when one name is not one of the five fixed priority levels, then it returns invalid_argument naming the five valid priority names.

Given a valid ticket id, when gorelo_get_ticket is called, then it returns the full ticket record (title, description, status, priority, type, source, client/contact/location, assignees, tags, linked assets, timestamps).

Given an unknown id, when gorelo_get_ticket, gorelo_get_client, gorelo_get_contact, gorelo_get_contract, or gorelo_get_agent_asset is called, then each returns a not_found error envelope, never an uncaught exception.

Given a valid ticket id and a comment body with no conversation_id, when gorelo_add_ticket_comment is called, then the comment is posted to the ticket's Public conversation and the tool returns the created comment's id.

Given a valid ticket id, a comment body, and a conversation_id from a prior side-conversation, when gorelo_add_ticket_comment is called, then the comment is posted into that conversation instead of the main thread.
Given title, client_id, status_name_or_id, type_name_or_id, and group_id, when gorelo_create_ticket is called, then a ticket is created and the tool returns its id and display number.

Given gorelo_create_ticket is called missing title, status, type, or group_id (each tried separately), then it returns invalid_argument naming the missing field, without calling the Gorelo create-ticket endpoint.

Given no filters, when gorelo_list_clients, gorelo_list_contacts, and gorelo_list_contracts are each called, then each returns up to limit records with the {items, has_more, next_cursor, total_count} envelope.
Given gorelo_list_clients(query="<a unique client name>"), when there is exactly one matching client, then only that client is returned.

Given gorelo_list_time_entries(ticket_ids="<id>"), when there are time entries logged against other tickets too, then only entries logged against the given ticket are returned, paged the same way as AC1.
Given a valid ticket id, started_on, and actual_hours, when gorelo_log_time_entry is called, then a time entry is created against that ticket and the tool returns its id.
Given gorelo_log_time_entry is called with neither ended_on nor actual_hours, and separately with both, then each call returns invalid_argument without calling the Gorelo time-entries endpoint.

Given no filters, when gorelo_list_agent_assets is called, then it returns up to limit devices with the required fields; given a valid agent_asset_id, gorelo_get_agent_asset returns the full device record.
Given a request to /mcp missing X-Gorelo-Api-Key and/or X-Gorelo-Region, when any tool is called, then the response is 401 naming the missing header(s), for every tool in the Tools table.

Given Gorelo returns HTTP 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429, or a 5xx/network error (one case per status), when any tool call hits that response, then the error envelope carries the correct code/retryable per the mapping table, with Gorelo's own Message and 6-digit Code preserved in the message text.

Given Gorelo responds with HTTP 200, IsSuccess: false, and a non-empty Notifications array, when a tool parses that response, then it is treated as an error using the same mapping table, not as a successful empty result.

Given the server is running, when tools/list is called, then it returns exactly the 17 tools in the Data & API contract table, each with a description <=500 chars (first line <=100 chars) and the correct readOnlyHint/destructiveHint.

Given a list tool (gorelo_list_tickets / _clients / _contacts / _contracts / _time_entries / _agent_assets) returns has_more: true and a next_cursor, when the same tool is called again with cursor=<next_cursor>, then it returns the next page of records, not a repeat of the first page.

Given two interleaved fake requests carrying different X-Gorelo-Api-Key/X-Gorelo-Region values, when both are processed concurrently, then neither request's outgoing Gorelo call ever carries the other request's credentials or base host.

Given a real Gorelo trial/sandbox account, when initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call is run for gorelo_list_tickets and gorelo_create_ticket, then both succeed end-to-end and the field names returned match what this design assumed from the fetched OpenAPI schema.
steps: Obtain a real Gorelo API key and region for a trial/sandbox service provider (Settings -> Integrations -> Generate New Key)
Start the server locally with that key/region in X-Gorelo-Api-Key / X-Gorelo-Region
Call initialize, then tools/list, confirm all 17 tools are listed
Call gorelo_list_tickets with no filters; inspect the returned fields against the Data & API contract table
Call gorelo_create_ticket with a minimal valid payload; confirm a ticket is created in the Gorelo UI and the tool's returned id/display number match it
expect: tools/list lists all 17 tools; gorelo_list_tickets returns a 200-shaped {items,...} result with the documented fields present and correctly typed; gorelo_create_ticket creates a real ticket visible in the Gorelo web UI with the same title/client, and returns that ticket's real id and display number.
notes: Not required before shipping (no test account is not a blocker per vendor-mcp-development SOP 'no vendor test account is not a blocker'). Recorded here so the dev leg files it as an explicit outstanding item rather than silently skipping it; closes the 'schema drift' risk noted in Risks & dependencies.

text: Given the repository at delivery time, when README.md's MSPbots Connector section is diffed against reference/readme-connector-section.md and the repo is scanned for CJK characters, then the section is verbatim-identical and no Chinese characters are found outside .git/.venv.
